desc: Set a user's profile information, including custom status.

token.desc: Authentication token bearing required scopes. Tokens should be passed as an HTTP Authorization header or alternatively, as a POST parameter.

name.desc: Name of a single key to set. Usable only if `profile` is not passed.

profile.desc: Collection of key:value pairs presented as a URL-encoded JSON hash. At most 50 fields may be set. Each field name is limited to 255 characters.

user.desc: ID of user to change. This argument may only be specified by admins on paid teams.

value.desc: Value to set a single key to. Usable only if `profile` is not passed.

cannot_update_admin_user.desc: Only a primary owner can update the profile of an admin.

invalid_profile.desc: Profile object passed in is not valid JSON (make sure it is URL encoded!).

must_clear_both_status_text_and_status_e.desc: Clearing the status requires setting both `status_text` and `status_emoji` to ''.

not_admin.desc: Only admins can update the profile of another user. Some fields, like `email` may only be updated by an admin.

not_app_admin.desc: Only team owners and selected members can update the profile of a bot user.

reserved_name.desc: First or last name are reserved.

too_long.desc: You attempted to set a custom status but it was longer than the maximum allowed, 100.

username_same.desc: Username is the same as the current username.
